rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: President Saito reads the notice received that day from Prime Minister Hashimoto (橋本内閣総理大臣): the cabinet has that day decided to resign en masse (Diet Act art. 64).

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: First ballot: 248 votes, majority 125; 小渕恵三 103, 菅直人 98, 浜四津敏子 24, 土井たか子 13, 小沢辰男 3, 武村正義 3, 4 blank. No majority; runoff between the two leaders under HC Rules art. 20(3).

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Runoff: 247 votes; 菅直人 142, 小渕恵三 103, 2 blank. The House of Councillors designates 菅直人; the President notes that the House of Representatives designated 小渕恵三 and that the House must request a joint committee under Diet Act art. 86(2).

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The chairman of the House's joint-committee members (本岡昭次), who chaired the joint committee by lot, reports that the committee heard the reasons for the Councillors' designation of 菅直人 and the Representatives' designation of 小渕恵三 and that neither vote (9 and 10 standing) reached two-thirds; the President declares that under Constitution art. 67(2) the House of Representatives' resolution becomes the Diet's resolution (sitting adjourned 17:20).

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-12 only. Each House's designation vote, any joint committee and the House of Representatives' prevailing resolution, the Imperial appointment ceremony, Kantei statements and accounts, a cabinet's formation, its resignation en masse, any continued performance of duties and acting service stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this role in this packet: an unnamed statement, agenda or ceremony record, an acting prime minister, the House of Councillors' 1998 designee or the successor at the closing boundary. Ministers, deputy prime ministers and party offices are excluded.
